title: Graph Representation
definition: Graphs consist of Vertices (nodes) and Edges (connections). They are typically represented in JS using an Adjacency List (an object/map where keys are vertices and values are arrays of neighbors).
simpleExplanation: A map of cities (Vertices) connected by highways (Edges).
